mapper.insert: MERGE INTO WELFARE W USING DUAL ON (W.PLCY_NO = #{plcyNo}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET W.LCLSF_NM = #{lclsfNm}, W.MCLSF_NM = #{mclsfNm}, W.MRG_STTS_CD = #{mrgSttsCd}, W.SCHOOL_CD = #{schoolCd}, W.PLCY_MAJOR_CD = #{plcyMajorCd}, W.JOB_CD = #{jobCd}, W.SBIZ_CD = #{sbizCd}, W.SPRT_TRGT_MIN_AGE = #{sprtTrgtMinAge}, W.SPRT_TRGT_MAX_AGE = #{sprtTrgtMaxAge}, W.SPRT_TRGT_AGE_LMT_YN = #{sprtTrgtAgeLmtYn}, W.EARN_MIN_AMT = #{earnMinAmt}, W.EARN_MAX_AMT = #{earnMaxAmt}, W.EARN_ETC_CN = #{earnEtcCn}, W.FULL_DATA = #{fullData} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (PLCY_NO, LCLSF_NM, MCLSF_NM, MRG_STTS_CD, SCHOOL_CD, PLCY_MAJOR_CD, JOB_CD, SBIZ_CD, SPRT_TRGT_MIN_AGE, SPRT_TRGT_MAX_AGE, SPRT_TRGT_AGE_LMT_YN, EARN_MIN_AMT, EARN_MAX_AMT, EARN_ETC_CN, FULL_DATA) VALUES(#{plcyNo}, #{lclsfNm}, #{mclsfNm}, #{mrgSttsCd}, #{schoolCd}, #{plcyMajorCd}, #{jobCd}, #{sbizCd}, #{sprtTrgtMinAge}, #{sprtTrgtMaxAge}, #{sprtTrgtAgeLmtYn}, #{earnMinAmt}, #{earnMaxAmt}, #{earnEtcCn}, #{fullData})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT WELFARE_ID AS welfareId, LCLSF_NM AS lclsfNm, JSON_VALUE(FULL_DATA, '$.plcyNm') AS plcyNm, JSON_VALUE(FULL_DATA, '$.aplyYmd') AS aplyYmd, JSON_VALUE(FULL_DATA, '$.sprvsnInstCdNm') AS sprvsnInstCdNm FROM WELFARE ORDER BY WELFARE_ID DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 4

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT WELFARE_ID AS welfareId, LCLSF_NM AS lclsfNm, JSON_VALUE(FULL_DATA, '$.plcyNm') AS plcyNm, JSON_VALUE(FULL_DATA, '$.aplyYmd') AS aplyYmd, JSON_VALUE(FULL_DATA, '$.sprvsnInstCdNm') AS sprvsnInstCdNm FROM WELFARE ORDER BY WELFARE_ID DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 10

SELECT WELFARE_ID AS welfareId, LCLSF_NM AS lclsfNm, JSON_VALUE(FULL_DATA, '$.plcyNm') AS plcyNm, JSON_VALUE(FULL_DATA, '$.sprvsnInstCdNm') AS sprvsnInstCdNm, JSON_VALUE(FULL_DATA, '$.lastMdfcnDt') AS lastMdfcnDt, JSON_VALUE(FULL_DATA, '$.sprtTrgtMinAge') AS sprtTrgtMinAge, JSON_VALUE(FULL_DATA, '$.sprtTrgtMaxAge') AS sprtTrgtMaxAge, JSON_VALUE(FULL_DATA, '$.ptcpPrpTrgtCn') AS ptcpPrpTrgtCn, JSON_VALUE(FULL_DATA, '$.earnEtcCn') AS earnEtcCn, JSON_VALUE(FULL_DATA, '$.plcySprtCn') AS plcySprtCn, JSON_VALUE(FULL_DATA, '$.aplyYmd') AS aplyYmd, JSON_VALUE(FULL_DATA, '$.plcyAplyMthdCn') AS plcyAplyMthdCn, JSON_VALUE(FULL_DATA, '$.srngMthdCn') AS srngMthdCn, JSON_VALUE(FULL_DATA, '$.aplyUrlAddr') AS aplyUrlAddr, JSON_VALUE(FULL_DATA, '$.plcyExplnCn') AS plcyExplnCn FROM WELFARE WHERE WELFARE_ID = #{id}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WELFARE WHERE 1=1
AND JSON_VALUE(FULL_DATA, '$.plcyNm') LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
AND (
(LCLSF_NM LIKE '%' || #{cat} || '%'
OR LCLSF_NM LIKE '%참여권리%'
OR LCLSF_NM LIKE '%복지문화%'
OR LCLSF_NM LIKE '%교육･직업훈련%'
)
)

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT WELFARE_ID AS welfareId, LCLSF_NM AS lclsfNm, JSON_VALUE(FULL_DATA, '$.plcyNm') AS plcyNm, JSON_VALUE(FULL_DATA, '$.aplyYmd') AS aplyYmd, JSON_VALUE(FULL_DATA, '$.sprvsnInstCdNm') AS sprvsnInstCdNm FROM WELFARE WHERE LCLSF_NM LIKE '%' || #{lclsfNm} || '%' AND WELFARE_ID != #{excludeId} ORDER BY DBMS_RANDOM.VALUE ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 3
